<![CDATA[import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Fira_Mono, Fira_Sans } from "next/font/google";
import "./rill/rill.css";

const display = Cormorant_Garamond({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["500", "600"],
  style: ["normal", "italic"],
  variable: "--font-cormorant",
  display: "swap",
});

const body = Fira_Sans({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500", "600"],
  variable: "--font-fira-sans",
  display: "swap",
});

const mono = Fira_Mono({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500"],
  variable: "--font-fira-mono",
  display: "swap",
  preload: false,
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "RILL — Field hydrology for farms that keep water in the ground",
  description: "Read the land, hold the rain, and design a field that keeps water where roots can use it.",
  openGraph: {
    title: "RILL — Make every drop take the long way",
    description: "A living watershed story for a field-hydrology studio.",
    type: "website",
  },
};

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  themeColor: "#F0E9DB",
  colorScheme: "light",
  width: "device-width",
  initialScale: 1,
};

export default function RillLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`} suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <noscript>
          <style>{`[data-reveal]{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important}[data-reveal] *{visibility:visible!important}`}</style>
        </noscript>
      </head>
      <body className="rl-body">{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/rill";

export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

type PictureProps = {
  assetKey: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
  sizes?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
};

export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className, sizes = "(min-width: 900px) 70vw, 100vw", priority }: PictureProps) {
  const webp800 = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!webp800) {
    return (
      <div className={`rl-media-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} data-asset={assetKey}>
        <span className="rl-mono">{assetKey}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  const set = (format: "webp" | "avif") => `${assetSrc(assetKey, 800, format)} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600, format)} 1600w`;
  return (
    <picture className={className} data-asset={assetKey}>
      <source type="image/avif" srcSet={set("avif")} sizes={sizes} />
      <img src={webp800} srcSet={set("webp")} sizes={sizes} width={w} height={h} alt={alt} loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"} fetchPriority={priority ? "high" : undefined} decoding="async" />
    </picture>
  );
}

export const CLIPS: Record<string, boolean> = {};

type VideoPlateProps = {
  clipKey: string;
  posterKey?: string;
  label: string;
  className?: string;
};

export function VideoPlate({ clipKey, posterKey, label, className }: VideoPlateProps) {
  if (!CLIPS[clipKey]) {
    return <Picture assetKey={posterKey ?? clipKey} alt={label} className={`rl-video-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} />;
  }
  return (
    <video className={className} data-clip={clipKey} aria-label={label} muted playsInline loop preload="metadata">
      <source src={`${BASE}/clips/${clipKey}.mp4`} type="video/mp4" />
    </video>
  );
}

]]>

<![CDATA[import { ImageResponse } from "next/og";

export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 };
export const contentType = "image/png";
export const alt = "RILL — Make every drop take the long way.";

const INK = "#14231E";
const PAPER = "#F0E9DB";
const OXIDE = "#B85C43";
const RIVER = "#5B8174";
const LICHEN = "#87956C";

export default function OpenGraphImage() {
  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", justifyContent: "space-between", backgroundColor: PAPER, color: INK, padding: "54px 64px", fontFamily: "sans-serif" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "18px" }}>
            <svg width="58" height="58" viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="none">
              <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="22" stroke={INK} strokeWidth="2" opacity=".35" />
              <path d="M12 37c12-14 23-15 37-5 5 3 9 4 13 2" stroke={RIVER} strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" />
              <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="5" fill={OXIDE} />
            </svg>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", fontSize: 40, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: "0.08em" }}>RILL</div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", padding: "10px 14px", border: `2px solid ${INK}`, fontSize: 14, letterSpacing: "0.14em" }}>FIELD / 042 MM</div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", maxWidth: 760 }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", fontSize: 78, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 0.98, letterSpacing: "-0.05em" }}>
              <span>Make every drop</span>
              <span>take the long way.</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", marginTop: 22, fontSize: 22, opacity: 0.72 }}>Field hydrology for farms that keep water in the ground.</div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 10, padding: 22, backgroundColor: INK, color: PAPER, width: 250 }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", fontSize: 13, color: OXIDE, letterSpacing: "0.15em" }}>ROOT ZONE / READY</div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", fontSize: 38, fontWeight: 700 }}>42 MM</div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", fontSize: 12, color: LICHEN }}>water held where roots can use it</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    ),
    { ...size },
  );
}

<![CDATA[import { Footer } from "./sections/Footer";
import { Header } from "./sections/Header";
import { Hero } from "./sections/Hero";
import { ReadTheLand } from "./sections/ReadTheLand";
import { WaterBudget } from "./sections/WaterBudget";
import { FieldSystems } from "./sections/FieldSystems";
import { FieldNotes } from "./sections/FieldNotes";
import { SeasonalLedger } from "./sections/SeasonalLedger";
import { FieldWalk } from "./sections/FieldWalk";
import { ProgressRail } from "./motion/ProgressRail";
import { WatershedProvider } from "./watershed/provider";

export default function RillPage() {
  return (
    <WatershedProvider>
      <div className="rl-shell">
        <a href="#main" className="rl-skip">Skip to the field</a>
        <Header />
        <ProgressRail items={[{ id: "land", label: "Land" }, { id: "budget", label: "Budget" }, { id: "systems", label: "Systems" }, { id: "notes", label: "Notes" }, { id: "ledger", label: "Ledger" }, { id: "field-walk", label: "Field walk" }]} />
        <main id="main" className="rl-main">
          <Hero />
          <ReadTheLand />
          <WaterBudget />
          <FieldSystems />
          <FieldNotes />
          <SeasonalLedger />
          <FieldWalk />
        </main>
        <Footer />
      </div>
    </WatershedProvider>
  );
}

<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  --color-basalt: #14231E;
  --color-limestone: #F0E9DB;
  --color-oxide: #B85C43;
  --color-riverstone: #5B8174;
  --color-lichen: #87956C;
  --color-silt: #C9B79E;
  --font-display: var(--font-cormorant), Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-fira-sans), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-fira-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --ease-spring: linear(0, 0.16 12%, 0.76 28%, 1.06 50%, 0.98 74%, 1);
  --dur-instant: 90ms;
  --dur-fast: 180ms;
  --dur-base: 480ms;
  --dur-slow: 920ms;
  --dur-hero: 1200ms;
  --reveal-shift: 28px;
  --stagger: 80ms;
}

:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --color-basalt: #14231E;
  --color-limestone: #F0E9DB;
  --color-oxide: #B85C43;
  --color-riverstone: #5B8174;
  --color-lichen: #87956C;
  --color-silt: #C9B79E;
  --font-display: var(--font-cormorant), Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-fira-sans), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-fira-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --ease-spring: linear(0, 0.16 12%, 0.76 28%, 1.06 50%, 0.98 74%, 1);
  --dur-instant: 90ms;
  --dur-fast: 180ms;
  --dur-base: 480ms;
  --dur-slow: 920ms;
  --dur-hero: 1200ms;
  --reveal-shift: 28px;
  --stagger: 80ms;
  --rl-gutter: clamp(20px, 5vw, 80px);
  --rl-container: 1320px;
  --rl-header-height: 64px;
  --rl-progress: 0;
  --rl-rain: 0;
  --rl-radius-card: 8px;
  --rl-radius-media: 6px;
  --rl-radius-pill: 999px;
  --rl-shadow-lift: 0 18px 40px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 14%, transparent);
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { background: var(--color-limestone); color: var(--color-basalt); scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 84px; overflow-x: clip; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--color-limestone); color: var(--color-basalt); font: 400 17px/1.6 var(--font-body); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; }
body.rl-body { caret-color: var(--color-oxide); }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: .2em; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
button { color: inherit; }
img, video { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
svg { display: block; }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin: 0; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.035em; line-height: .98; text-wrap: balance; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(3.6rem, 10vw, 9.5rem); }
h2 { font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 6vw, 6.5rem); }
h3 { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.8vw, 3.4rem); }
::selection { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oxide) 28%, transparent); color: var(--color-basalt); }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-oxide); outline-offset: 4px; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

.rl-shell { min-height: 100svh; overflow: clip; }
.rl-main { position: relative; }
.rl-container { width: 100%; max-width: var(--rl-container); margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--rl-gutter); }
.rl-skip { position: fixed; z-index: 1000; top: 12px; left: 12px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-basalt); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-pill); background: var(--color-limestone); font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: translateY(-180%); transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-skip:focus { transform: none; }
.rl-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-visually-hidden { position: absolute !important; width: 1px !important; height: 1px !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: -1px !important; overflow: hidden !important; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important; white-space: nowrap !important; border: 0 !important; }
.rl-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 66%, var(--color-limestone)); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 28px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; }
.rl-section { position: relative; padding-block: clamp(96px, 13vw, 190px); }
.rl-section--dark { background: var(--color-basalt); color: var(--color-limestone); }
.rl-section-head { display: grid; gap: 20px; max-width: 760px; margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 7vw, 92px); }
.rl-section-head--center { margin-inline: auto; text-align: center; justify-items: center; }
.rl-section-title { max-width: 13ch; }
.rl-section-lead { max-width: 56ch; color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 70%, transparent); }
.rl-rule { width: 100%; height: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 22%, transparent); transform-origin: left; }

/* Header */
.rl-header { position: fixed; z-index: 300; inset: 0 0 auto; height: var(--rl-header-height); color: var(--color-basalt); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 90%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 14%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-header[data-state="hidden"] { transform: translateY(-100%); }
.rl-header[data-state="compact"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 96%, transparent); }
.rl-header__inner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 100%; }
.rl-header__brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
.rl-header__brand svg { width: 38px; height: 38px; }
.rl-header__wordmark { font: 600 18px/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.rl-header__nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(14px, 2vw, 30px); margin-inline: auto; }
.rl-header__link { position: relative; padding: 22px 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 68%, transparent); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-header__link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 15px; height: 1px; background: var(--color-oxide); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-header__link:hover, .rl-header__link:focus-visible, .rl-header__link[data-active="true"] { color: var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-header__link:hover::after, .rl-header__link:focus-visible::after, .rl-header__link[data-active="true"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.rl-header__rain { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 3px; min-width: 78px; }
.rl-header__rain-label { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 56%, transparent); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-header__rain-value { font: 500 15px/1 var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rl-header__menu { display: none; width: 42px; height: 42px; margin-left: auto; padding: 0; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; }
.rl-header__menu span, .rl-header__menu::before, .rl-header__menu::after { display: block; width: 16px; height: 1px; margin: 4px auto; background: currentColor; content: ""; transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-spring); }
.rl-header__menu[data-open="true"] span { opacity: 0; }
.rl-header__menu[data-open="true"]::before { transform: translateY(5px) rotate(45deg); }
.rl-header__menu[data-open="true"]::after { transform: translateY(-5px) rotate(-45deg); }
.rl-header__progress { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; height: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 10%, transparent); }
.rl-header__progress span { display: block; width: calc(var(--rl-progress) * 100%); height: 100%; background: var(--color-oxide); transform-origin: left; }
.rl-header__mobile-panel { position: fixed; z-index: -1; inset: var(--rl-header-height) 0 0; display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 18px; padding: 34px var(--rl-gutter); background: var(--color-limestone); clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); animation: rl-menu-open var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out) both; }
.rl-header__mobile-panel a:not(.rl-button) { padding-block: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 18%, transparent); font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; }
@keyframes rl-menu-open { from { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0); } }

/* Buttons and media */
.rl-button { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: var(--rl-radius-pill); background: transparent; font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; overflow: hidden; transition: transform var(--dur-instant) var(--ease-spring), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-button::before { position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 0; background: var(--color-oxide); content: ""; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: var(--rl-origin, left); transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-button span { position: relative; }
.rl-button:hover::before, .rl-button:focus-visible::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.rl-button:hover, .rl-button:focus-visible { color: var(--color-limestone); }
.rl-button:active { transform: scale(.97); transition-timing-function: var(--ease-spring); }
.rl-button--primary { color: var(--color-limestone); border-color: var(--color-oxide); background: var(--color-oxide); }
.rl-button--primary::before { background: var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-button--quiet { color: var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-hero .rl-button--quiet { color: var(--color-limestone); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 54%, transparent); }
.rl-hero .rl-button--quiet::before { background: var(--color-limestone); }
.rl-hero .rl-button--quiet:hover, .rl-hero .rl-button--quiet:focus-visible { color: var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-button__arrow { display: inline-block; transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-button:hover .rl-button__arrow, .rl-button:focus-visible .rl-button__arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }
.rl-media { position: relative; overflow: clip; border-radius: var(--rl-radius-media); background: var(--color-silt); }
.rl-media > img, .rl-media > picture, .rl-media > video { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.rl-media-placeholder { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 240px; overflow: clip; border-radius: inherit; background-color: var(--color-silt); background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 22% 38%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-riverstone) 26%, var(--color-limestone)) 0 1px, transparent 1px 22px), linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-silt) 76%, var(--color-limestone)), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-silt) 54%, var(--color-basalt))); color: var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-media-placeholder::before { position: absolute; inset: 14%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 28%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; content: ""; transform: rotate(-18deg) scaleX(1.3); }
.rl-media-placeholder::after { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(120deg, transparent 38%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 36%, transparent) 38.2%, transparent 39%); content: ""; opacity: .7; }
.rl-media-placeholder .rl-mono { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid currentColor; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 72%, transparent); }
.rl-video-placeholder { min-height: 100%; }

/* Hero */
.rl-hero { position: relative; display: grid; min-height: min(92svh, 860px); isolation: isolate; overflow: clip; color: var(--color-limestone); background: var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-hero__media, .rl-hero__scrim { position: absolute; z-index: -2; inset: 0; }
.rl-hero__media > *, .rl-hero__media .rl-media-placeholder { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 100%; border-radius: 0; }
.rl-hero__media .rl-media-placeholder { background-color: var(--color-basalt); background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 62%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-riverstone) 58%, var(--color-basalt)) 0 1px, transparent 1px 42px), linear-gradient(160deg, var(--color-basalt), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 78%, var(--color-silt))); }
.rl-hero__media .rl-media-placeholder::before { inset: 16% 10%; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 35%, transparent); }
.rl-hero__media .rl-media-placeholder .rl-mono { position: absolute; top: 28%; right: 8%; }
.rl-hero__scrim { z-index: -1; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 86%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 28%, transparent) 72%, transparent), linear-gradient(0deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 84%, transparent), transparent 58%); }
.rl-hero__content { display: grid; align-content: end; width: 100%; min-height: min(92svh, 860px); padding-block: calc(var(--rl-header-height) + 48px) 56px; }
.rl-hero__eyebrow { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 74%, transparent); }
.rl-hero__title { max-width: 8ch; margin-top: 22px; }
.rl-hero__title em { color: var(--color-oxide); font-style: italic; }
.rl-hero__lead { max-width: 42ch; margin-top: 24px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 78%, transparent); font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.5vw, 1.35rem); }
.rl-hero__actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 32px; }
.rl-hero__meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 34px; align-items: end; margin-top: clamp(56px, 11vw, 130px); padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 26%, transparent); }
.rl-hero__meta-item { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.rl-hero__meta-label { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 56%, transparent); }
.rl-hero__meta-value { font: 500 14px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .04em; }

/* Stage */
.rl-land { position: relative; min-height: 360svh; background: var(--color-basalt); color: var(--color-limestone); }
.rl-land__stage { position: sticky; top: 0; display: grid; min-height: 100svh; align-items: center; overflow: clip; }
.rl-land__media { position: absolute; z-index: 0; inset: 0; }
.rl-land__plate { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.06); transition: opacity var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-in-out), transform var(--dur-hero) var(--ease-out-expo); }
.rl-land__plate[data-active="true"] { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.rl-land__plate .rl-media-placeholder { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 100%; border-radius: 0; background-color: var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-land__plate:nth-child(1) .rl-media-placeholder { background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 38% 40%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-riverstone) 50%, var(--color-basalt)) 0 1px, transparent 1px 34px), linear-gradient(150deg, var(--color-basalt), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 60%, var(--color-silt))); }
.rl-land__plate:nth-child(2) .rl-media-placeholder { background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 58% 54%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oxide) 42%, var(--color-basalt)) 0 2px, transparent 2px 20px), linear-gradient(150deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 75%, var(--color-silt)), var(--color-basalt)); }
.rl-land__plate:nth-child(3) .rl-media-placeholder { background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 64% 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-lichen) 52%, var(--color-basalt)) 0 3px, transparent 3px 25px), linear-gradient(150deg, var(--color-basalt), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-riverstone) 34%, var(--color-basalt))); }
.rl-land__plate:nth-child(4) .rl-media-placeholder { background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 52% 66%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-riverstone) 62%, var(--color-basalt)) 0 4px, transparent 4px 28px), linear-gradient(150deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 64%, var(--color-lichen)), var(--color-basalt)); }
.rl-land__plate .rl-media-placeholder::before { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 30%, transparent); }
.rl-land__plate .rl-media-placeholder .rl-mono { color: var(--color-limestone); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 72%, transparent); }
.rl-land__veil { position: absolute; z-index: 1; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 90%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 36%, transparent) 65%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 68%, transparent)), linear-gradient(0deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 80%, transparent), transparent 65%); }
.rl-land__overlay { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(280px, .7fr); gap: 40px; align-items: end; width: 100%; min-height: 100svh; padding-block: calc(var(--rl-header-height) + 48px) 48px; }
.rl-land__copy { align-self: end; max-width: 520px; }
.rl-land__copy h2 { max-width: 7ch; margin-top: 18px; }
.rl-land__copy p { max-width: 38ch; margin-top: 22px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 72%, transparent); }
.rl-land__phase { display: inline-flex; gap: 9px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 28%, transparent); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-pill); color: var(--color-limestone); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-land__phase::before { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-riverstone); content: ""; }
.rl-land__hud { align-self: end; justify-self: end; width: min(100%, 360px); padding: 22px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 30%, transparent); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-card); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 68%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
.rl-land__hud-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; align-items: baseline; }
.rl-land__hud-title { font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-land__hud-value { color: var(--color-oxide); font: 500 clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)/.9 var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rl-land__hud-unit { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 55%, transparent); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; }
.rl-land__range { width: 100%; margin: 24px 0 14px; accent-color: var(--color-oxide); }
.rl-land__range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 30%, transparent); }
.rl-land__range::-webkit-slider-thumb { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: -8px; border: 2px solid var(--color-limestone); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-oxide); appearance: none; }
.rl-land__range::-moz-range-track { height: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 30%, transparent); }
.rl-land__range::-moz-range-thumb { width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--color-limestone); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-oxide); }
.rl-land__hud-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 60%, transparent); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-land__contours { position: absolute; z-index: 1; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.rl-land__contours svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.rl-land__contour { fill: none; stroke: var(--color-riverstone); stroke-width: .14; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; opacity: .45; stroke-dasharray: 100; stroke-dashoffset: calc(100 - (var(--rl-progress) * 100)); transition: stroke-dashoffset var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-land__contour--accent { stroke: var(--color-oxide); stroke-width: .32; opacity: .95; }
.rl-land__drop { position: absolute; z-index: 2; left: calc(8% + (var(--rl-progress) * 84%)); top: calc(18% + (var(--rl-progress) * 64%)); width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 3px solid var(--color-limestone); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-oxide); box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-oxide) 22%, transparent); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transition: left var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), top var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-land__fallback-list { display: none; gap: 1px; padding-block: 24px 64px; }
.rl-land__fallback-list > div { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 18px 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 24%, transparent); }
.rl-land__fallback-list p { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 68%, transparent); }

/* Budget */
.rl-budget { background: var(--color-limestone); color: var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-budget__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(32px, 7vw, 110px); align-items: end; }
.rl-budget__intro { display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.rl-budget__intro h2 { max-width: 8ch; }
.rl-budget__intro p { max-width: 40ch; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 68%, transparent); }
.rl-budget__readout { padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-card); background: var(--color-basalt); color: var(--color-limestone); }
.rl-budget__readout-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: end; gap: 18px; padding-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 22%, transparent); }
.rl-budget__readout-title { font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-budget__readout-mm { color: var(--color-oxide); font: 500 clamp(2.8rem, 8vw, 6rem)/.85 var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rl-budget__stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; padding-top: 22px; }
.rl-budget__stat { display: grid; gap: 9px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 18%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; }
.rl-budget__stat-label { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 56%, transparent); font: 500 10px/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-budget__stat-value { font: 500 24px/1 var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rl-budget__meter { position: relative; height: 10px; margin-top: 28px; border-radius: var(--rl-radius-pill); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 16%, transparent); overflow: hidden; }
.rl-budget__meter span { display: block; width: calc(var(--rl-meter, 0) * 1%); height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--color-riverstone); transform-origin: left; transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); transform: scaleX(1); }
.rl-budget__note { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-top: 12px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 60%, transparent); font: 500 10px/1.3 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-budget[data-status="ready"] .rl-budget__meter span { background: var(--color-lichen); }

/* Systems */
.rl-systems { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-silt) 38%, var(--color-limestone)); }
.rl-systems__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
.rl-system-card { display: grid; grid-template-rows: minmax(220px, 26vw) 1fr; min-height: 540px; overflow: clip; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 22%, transparent); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-card); background: var(--color-limestone); transform: translateY(var(--rl-lift, 0)) rotate(var(--rl-tilt, 0deg)); transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-system-card[data-align="center"] { margin-top: 36px; }
.rl-system-card[data-align="right"] { margin-top: 72px; }
.rl-system-card__media { position: relative; overflow: clip; }
.rl-system-card__media > * { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 100%; border-radius: 0; }
.rl-system-card__media::after { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 18%, transparent); content: ""; pointer-events: none; }
.rl-system-card__body { display: grid; align-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 22px; }
.rl-system-card__eyebrow { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 56%, transparent); }
.rl-system-card__title { max-width: 12ch; }
.rl-system-card__copy { max-width: 32ch; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 68%, transparent); }
.rl-system-card__metric { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 18%, transparent); color: var(--color-riverstone); font: 500 12px/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .rl-system-card:hover { --rl-lift: -8px; --rl-tilt: -1deg; box-shadow: var(--rl-shadow-lift); } .rl-system-card:hover .rl-system-card__media > * { transform: scale(1.04); transition: transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out); } }

/* Notes */
.rl-notes { background: var(--color-basalt); color: var(--color-limestone); overflow: clip; }
.rl-notes__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; align-items: end; }
.rl-notes__head p { max-width: 34ch; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 64%, transparent); text-align: right; }
.rl-notes__rail { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(280px, 31vw); gap: 16px; margin-top: 48px; padding-bottom: 12px; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-inline: contain; scrollbar-color: var(--color-riverstone) color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 10%, transparent); }
.rl-note { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 190px 1fr; min-height: 430px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 24%, transparent); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-card); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 8%, transparent); transform: translateY(var(--rl-note-lift, 0)); transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-note__media > * { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 100%; border-radius: var(--rl-radius-card) var(--rl-radius-card) 0 0; }
.rl-note__body { display: grid; align-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 20px; }
.rl-note__top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; align-items: start; }
.rl-note__farm { font: 600 27px/.96 var(--font-display); }
.rl-note__region { margin-top: 7px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 56%, transparent); }
.rl-note__stamp { padding: 7px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-oxide); color: var(--color-oxide); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; transform: rotate(-3deg); }
.rl-note__numbers { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 20%, transparent); }
.rl-note__number { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.rl-note__number strong { font: 500 20px/1 var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rl-note__number span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 52%, transparent); font: 500 9px/1.1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-note__copy { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 70%, transparent); }
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .rl-note:hover { --rl-note-lift: -6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 13%, transparent); } }

/* Ledger */
.rl-ledger { background: var(--color-limestone); }
.rl-ledger__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, .38fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: clamp(30px, 8vw, 120px); align-items: start; }
.rl-ledger__intro { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--rl-header-height) + 30px); display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.rl-ledger__intro p { max-width: 30ch; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 66%, transparent); }
.rl-ledger__line { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 30px; width: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 20%, transparent); }
.rl-ledger__months { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
.rl-ledger__month { position: relative; min-height: 126px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 18%, transparent); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-card); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-silt) 36%, var(--color-limestone)); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out), background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-ledger__month::before { position: absolute; top: 18px; left: -21px; width: 11px; height: 11px; border: 2px solid var(--color-limestone); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-riverstone); content: ""; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-basalt); }
.rl-ledger__month[data-active="true"] { color: var(--color-limestone); background: var(--color-basalt); transform: translateY(-5px); }
.rl-ledger__month[data-marker="rain"]::before { background: var(--color-oxide); }
.rl-ledger__month[data-marker="plant"]::before { background: var(--color-lichen); }
.rl-ledger__month[data-marker="harvest"]::before { background: var(--color-silt); }
.rl-ledger__month-code { display: block; color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 58%, transparent); }
.rl-ledger__month-title { display: block; margin-top: 26px; font: 600 21px/.98 var(--font-display); }
.rl-ledger__detail { margin-top: 32px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 20%, transparent); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-card); }
.rl-ledger__detail h3 { max-width: 16ch; }
.rl-ledger__detail p { max-width: 50ch; margin-top: 12px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 68%, transparent); }

/* Field walk form */
.rl-fieldwalk { background: var(--color-silt); }
.rl-fieldwalk__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(32px, 8vw, 120px); align-items: start; }
.rl-fieldwalk__intro { display: grid; gap: 20px; }
.rl-fieldwalk__intro p { max-width: 36ch; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 68%, transparent); }
.rl-form { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 44px); border-radius: var(--rl-radius-card); background: var(--color-limestone); }
.rl-form__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 16px; }
.rl-form__field { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.rl-form__field--wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.rl-label { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 60%, transparent); font: 500 10px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 13px 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 24%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; outline: none; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 54%, var(--color-silt)); color: var(--color-basalt); transition: border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); }
textarea.rl-input { min-height: 132px; resize: vertical; }
.rl-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-riverstone); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-riverstone) 20%, transparent); }
.rl-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-oxide); }
.rl-error { color: var(--color-oxide); font: 500 11px/1.2 var(--font-mono); }
.rl-form__foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; align-items: center; padding-top: 8px; }
.rl-form__hint { max-width: 32ch; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-basalt) 60%, transparent); font-size: 13px; }
.rl-submit[data-state="loading"] { pointer-events: none; }
.rl-submit[data-state="loading"] .rl-button__label { opacity: 0; }
.rl-submit[data-state="loading"]::after { position: absolute; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); border-top-color: currentColor; border-radius: 50%; content: ""; animation: rl-spin 700ms linear infinite; }
.rl-form__success { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding-block: 42px; }
.rl-form__success-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-lichen); color: var(--color-basalt); font: 500 22px/1 var(--font-mono); }
.rl-form__success h3 { max-width: 12ch; }

/* Footer */
.rl-footer { position: relative; padding-block: 84px 40px; background: var(--color-basalt); color: var(--color-limestone); overflow: clip; }
.rl-footer__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(260px, .72fr); gap: 48px; align-items: end; }
.rl-footer__brand { display: grid; gap: 22px; }
.rl-footer__brand svg { width: min(260px, 60vw); }
.rl-footer__tagline { max-width: 24ch; font: 600 clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 6.5rem)/.88 var(--font-display); }
.rl-footer__meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 22px 32px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 58%, transparent); }
.rl-footer__links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; justify-content: flex-end; font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rl-footer__links a { position: relative; text-decoration: none; }
.rl-footer__links a::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -8px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--color-oxide); content: ""; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); }
.rl-footer__links a:hover::after, .rl-footer__links a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.rl-ecosystem { margin-top: 74px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 22%, transparent); }
.rl-ecosystem__diagram { width: 100%; height: auto; color: var(--color-limestone); }
.rl-ecosystem__diagram path, .rl-ecosystem__diagram circle { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
.rl-ecosystem__caption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-top: 10px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 52%, transparent); }

/* Reveal and ambient motion: hidden states only apply when motion is allowed. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  [data-reveal] { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--reveal-shift)); }
  [data-reveal][data-in="true"] { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: opacity var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out); transition-delay: calc(var(--rl-index, 0) * var(--stagger)); }
  [data-reveal="line"] { transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; }
  [data-reveal="line"][data-in="true"] { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .rl-hero__media { animation: rl-hero-settle var(--dur-hero) var(--ease-out-expo) both; }
  .rl-hero__eyebrow, .rl-hero__title, .rl-hero__lead, .rl-hero__actions, .rl-hero__meta { animation: rl-hero-rise var(--dur-hero) var(--ease-out) both; }
  .rl-hero__eyebrow { animation-delay: 150ms; }
  .rl-hero__title { animation-delay: 280ms; }

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { validateFieldWalk, type FieldWalkErrors, type FieldWalkInput } from "./validation";

const initial: FieldWalkInput = { name: "", farm: "", email: "", acres: "", goal: "" };

export function FieldWalkForm() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<FieldWalkInput>(initial);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<FieldWalkErrors>({});
  const [state, setState] = useState<"idle" | "loading" | "success">("idle");

  const update = (field: keyof FieldWalkInput, value: string) => {
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: undefined }));
  };

  const onSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const result = validateFieldWalk(values);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setErrors(result.errors);
      setState("idle");
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    setState("loading");
    window.setTimeout(() => setState("success"), 650);
  };

  if (state === "success") {
    return <div className="rl-form__success" role="status" aria-live="polite"><span className="rl-form__success-mark" aria-hidden="true">✓</span><h3>The field is on the map.</h3><p>We’ll bring the contour notes and a clean way to read the next storm.</p><button className="rl-button rl-button--quiet" type="button" onClick={() => { setValues(initial); setState("idle"); }}><span>Send another note</span><span className="rl-button__arrow">↗</span></button></div>;
  }

  const describedBy = (field: keyof FieldWalkInput) => errors[field] ? `${field}-error` : undefined;
  return (
    <form className="rl-form" onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate aria-describedby="rl-form-hint">
      <div className="rl-form__grid">
        <label className="rl-form__field"><span className="rl-label">Your name</span><input className="rl-input" name="name" value={values.name} onChange={(event) => update("name", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)} aria-describedby={describedBy("name")} autoComplete="name" />{errors.name ? <span id="name-error" className="rl-error">{errors.name}</span> : null}</label>
        <label className="rl-form__field"><span className="rl-label">Farm or field</span><input className="rl-input" name="farm" value={values.farm} onChange={(event) => update("farm", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.farm)} aria-describedby={describedBy("farm")} />{errors.farm ? <span id="farm-error" className="rl-error">{errors.farm}</span> : null}</label>
        <label className="rl-form__field"><span className="rl-label">Email</span><input className="rl-input" type="email" name="email" value={values.email} onChange={(event) => update("email", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)} aria-describedby={describedBy("email")} autoComplete="email" />{errors.email ? <span id="email-error" className="rl-error">{errors.email}</span> : null}</label>
        <label className="rl-form__field"><span className="rl-label">Acres</span><input className="rl-input" type="number" min="0.1" step="0.1" name="acres" value={values.acres} onChange={(event) => update("acres", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.acres)} aria-describedby={describedBy("acres")} inputMode="decimal" />{errors.acres ? <span id="acres-error" className="rl-error">{errors.acres}</span> : null}</label>
        <label className="rl-form__field rl-form__field--wide"><span className="rl-label">What should the field hold?</span><textarea className="rl-input" name="goal" value={values.goal} maxLength={600} onChange={(event) => update("goal", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.goal)} aria-describedby={describedBy("goal")} />{errors.goal ? <span id="goal-error" className="rl-error">{errors.goal}</span> : null}</label>
      </div>
      <div className="rl-form__foot"><p id="rl-form-hint" className="rl-form__hint">A first field walk is a 30-minute read of slope, soil and the next useful line.</p><button className="rl-button rl-button--primary rl-submit" type="submit" data-state={state}><span className="rl-button__label">{state === "loading" ? "Reading the field" : "Request a field walk"}</span><span className="rl-button__arrow">↗</span></button></div>
    </form>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/forms/validation.ts">
<![CDATA[export type FieldWalkInput = {
  name: string;
  farm: string;
  email: string;
  acres: string;
  goal: string;
};

export type FieldWalkErrors = Partial<Record<keyof FieldWalkInput, string>>;

export type FieldWalkResult =
  | { ok: true; data: FieldWalkInput }
  | { ok: false; errors: FieldWalkErrors };

const emailPattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

export function validateFieldWalk(input: FieldWalkInput): FieldWalkResult {
  const data: FieldWalkInput = {
    name: input.name.trim(),
    farm: input.farm.trim(),
    email: input.email.trim(),
    acres: input.acres.trim(),
    goal: input.goal.trim(),
  };
  const errors: FieldWalkErrors = {};

  if (!data.name) errors.name = "Add your name.";
  if (!data.farm) errors.farm = "Add your farm or field name.";
  if (!emailPattern.test(data.email)) errors.email = "Enter a valid email.";
  const acres = Number(data.acres);
  if (!data.acres || !Number.isFinite(acres) || acres <= 0) errors.acres = "Enter a positive acreage.";
  if (data.goal.length > 600) errors.goal = "Keep the note under 600 characters.";

  return Object.keys(errors).length > 0 ? { ok: false, errors } : { ok: true, data };
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/motion/Magnetic.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

export function Magnetic({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement | null>(null);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || reduced || !window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches) return;
    let frame = 0;
    let x = 0;
    let y = 0;
    const render = () => {
      frame = 0;
      node.style.setProperty("--rl-mx", `${x}px`);
      node.style.setProperty("--rl-my", `${y}px`);
    };
    const onMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      const box = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      x = (event.clientX - (box.left + box.width / 2)) * 0.12;
      y = (event.clientY - (box.top + box.height / 2)) * 0.12;
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };
    const reset = () => { x = 0; y = 0; if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(render); };
    node.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    node.addEventListener("pointerleave", reset);
    return () => { node.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove); node.removeEventListener("pointerleave", reset); if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame); };
  }, [reduced]);

  return <span ref={ref} className="rl-magnetic">{children}</span>;
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/motion/math.ts">
<![CDATA[export function clamp01(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value));
}

export function lerp(start: number, end: number, amount: number): number {
  return start + (end - start) * clamp01(amount);
}

export function progressFromOffsets(rectTop: number, rectHeight: number, viewportHeight: number): number {
  const travel = Math.max(0, rectHeight - viewportHeight);
  if (travel === 0) return 0;
  return clamp01(-rectTop / travel);
}

export function staggerDelay(index: number, baseMilliseconds: number): string {
  return `${Math.max(0, index) * Math.max(0, baseMilliseconds)}ms`;
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/motion/ProgressRail.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type Item = { id: string; label: string };

export function ProgressRail({ items }: { items: Item[] }) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(items[0]?.id ?? "");

  useEffect(() => {
    const nodes = items.map((item) => document.getElementById(item.id)).filter((node): node is HTMLElement => Boolean(node));
    if (!nodes.length || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      const visible = entries.filter((entry) => entry.isIntersecting).sort((a, b) => b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio)[0];
      if (visible?.target.id) setActive(visible.target.id);
    }, { threshold: [0.2, 0.5, 0.8], rootMargin: "-20% 0px -55%" });
    nodes.forEach((node) => observer.observe(node));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [items]);

  return (
    <nav className="rl-progress-rail" aria-label="Page chapters">
      {items.map((item) => <a key={item.id} href={`#${item.id}`} data-active={active === item.id ? "true" : undefined}>{item.label}</a>)}
    </nav>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/motion/Reveal.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

type RevealProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  index?: number;
  kind?: "rise" | "line" | "wipe";
};

export function Reveal({ children, className, index = 0, kind = "rise" }: RevealProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || reduced || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      node?.setAttribute("data-in", "true");
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      if (entry?.isIntersecting) {
        node.setAttribute("data-in", "true");
        observer.disconnect();
      }
    }, { threshold: 0.16, rootMargin: "0px 0px -8%" });
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [reduced]);

  return <div ref={ref} className={className} data-reveal={kind} style={{ "--rl-index": index } as CSSProperties}>{children}</div>;
}

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

type SplitTextProps = {

  className?: string;
};

export function SplitText({ children, className }: SplitTextProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const lines = children.split("\n");
  return (
    <span className={className} data-split-text>
      {lines.map((line, index) => (
        <span key={`${line}-${index}`} className="rl-split-line" style={{ "--rl-index": index } as CSSProperties}>
          <span className={reduced ? undefined : "rl-split-line__inner"}>{line}</span>
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

export function TiltCard({ children, className = "", dataAlign }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string; dataAlign?: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || reduced || !window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches) return;
    let frame = 0;
    let rx = 0;
    let ry = 0;
    const render = () => { frame = 0; node.style.setProperty("--rl-rx", `${rx}deg`); node.style.setProperty("--rl-ry", `${ry}deg`); };
    const onMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      const box = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = (event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5;
      const py = (event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5;
      ry = px * 4;
      rx = py * -4;
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };
    const reset = () => { rx = 0; ry = 0; if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(render); };
    node.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    node.addEventListener("pointerleave", reset);
    return () => { node.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove); node.removeEventListener("pointerleave", reset); if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame); };
  }, [reduced]);

  return <article ref={ref} className={`rl-tilt-card ${className}`} data-align={dataAlign}>{children}</article>;
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/motion/useInView.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from "react";

export function useInView<T extends HTMLElement>(options?: IntersectionObserverInit): [RefObject<T | null>, boolean] {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      setInView(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      if (entry?.isIntersecting) {
        setInView(true);
        observer.disconnect();
      }
    }, options);
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [options]);

  return [ref, inView];
}

]]>

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/motion/useReducedMotion.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

const query = "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)";

function subscribe(onStoreChange: () => void) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return () => undefined;
  const media = window.matchMedia(query);
  media.addEventListener("change", onStoreChange);
  return () => media.removeEventListener("change", onStoreChange);
}

function getSnapshot() {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia(query).matches;
}

export function useReducedMotion() {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, () => false);
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/motion/useScrollProgress.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import type { RefObject } from "react";
import { progressFromOffsets } from "./math";

export function useScrollProgress(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, onProgress: (progress: number) => void, enabled = true) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    let frame = 0;
    const update = () => {
      frame = 0;
      const node = ref.current;
      if (!node) return;
      const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      onProgress(progressFromOffsets(rect.top, rect.height, window.innerHeight));
    };
    const onScroll = () => { if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(update); };
    update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onScroll);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll); window.removeEventListener("resize", onScroll); if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame); };
  }, [enabled, onProgress, ref]);
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

const links = [
  ["land", "Read the land"],
  ["budget", "Water budget"],
  ["systems", "Field systems"],
  ["field-walk", "Field walk"],
] as const;

export function Header() {
  const { rain } = useWatershed();
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [headerState, setHeaderState] = useState<"top" | "compact" | "hidden">("top");
  const previousScroll = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      const scroll = window.scrollY;
      const delta = scroll - previousScroll.current;
      setHeaderState(scroll < 72 ? "top" : delta > 5 ? "hidden" : "compact");
      previousScroll.current = scroll;
      const max = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--rl-progress", String(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, scroll / max))));
    };
    update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", update);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = menuOpen ? "hidden" : "";
    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = ""; };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  return (
    <header className="rl-header" data-state={headerState}>
      <div className="rl-container rl-header__inner">
        <a className="rl-header__brand" href="#top" aria-label="RILL home">
          <Logo variant="mark" />
          <span className="rl-header__wordmark">RILL</span>

        <nav className="rl-header__nav" aria-label="Primary">

      </div>
      <div className="rl-header__progress" aria-hidden="true"><span /></div>
      {menuOpen ? (
        <div className="rl-header__mobile-panel">
          {links.map(([id, label]) => <a key={id} href={`#${id}`} onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>{label}</a>)}
          <a className="rl-button rl-button--primary" href="#field-walk" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}><span>Book a field walk</span><span className="rl-button__arrow">↗</span></a>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </header>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import { createContext, useContext, useRef, useSyncExternalStore, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { createWatershedStore, type WatershedStore } from "./store";

const WatershedContext = createContext<WatershedStore | null>(null);

export function WatershedProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const storeRef = useRef<WatershedStore | null>(null);
  if (!storeRef.current) storeRef.current = createWatershedStore(0);
  return <WatershedContext.Provider value={storeRef.current}>{children}</WatershedContext.Provider>;
}

export function useWatershed() {
  const store = useContext(WatershedContext);
  if (!store) throw new Error("useWatershed must be used inside WatershedProvider");
  const rain = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.getSnapshot, () => 0);
  return { store, rain };
}

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/watershed/store.ts">
<![CDATA[export type WatershedListener = () => void;

export type WatershedStore = {
  getSnapshot: () => number;
  subscribe: (listener: WatershedListener) => () => void;
  setRain: (millimeters: number) => void;
};

const clampRain = (value: number) => Math.min(80, Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0));

export function createWatershedStore(initialRain = 0): WatershedStore {
  let rain = clampRain(initialRain);
  const listeners = new Set<WatershedListener>();

  return {
    getSnapshot: () => rain,
    subscribe(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => listeners.delete(listener);
    },
    setRain(next) {
      const value = clampRain(next);
      if (Object.is(value, rain)) return;
      rain = value;
      listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    },
  };
}

]]>

    <file path="src/app/(rill)/rill/watershed/water.ts">
<![CDATA[import { clamp01 } from "../motion/math";

export type WatershedPhase = "ridge" | "swale" | "storage" | "root-zone";
export type WaterStatus = "dry" | "holding" | "ready";

export type WaterBudget = {
  runoff: number;
  storage: number;
  rootZone: number;
  status: WaterStatus;
};

function roundOne(value: number): number {
  return Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
}

export function rainfallAt(progress: number): number {
  return Math.round(clamp01(progress) * 80);
}

export function progressAtRainfall(millimeters: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(millimeters)) return 0;
  return clamp01(millimeters / 80);
}

export function waterBudget(millimeters: number): WaterBudget {
  const mm = Math.min(80, Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(millimeters) ? millimeters : 0));
  const runoff = roundOne(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (mm - 26) * 1.2)));
  const storage = roundOne(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, mm * 0.92 - runoff * 0.24)));
  const rootZone = roundOne(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, storage * 0.74)));
  const status: WaterStatus = mm < 18 ? "dry" : mm < 42 ? "holding" : "ready";
  return { runoff, storage, rootZone, status };
}

export function watershedPhase(progress: number): WatershedPhase {
  const p = clamp01(progress);
  if (p < 0.2) return "ridge";
  if (p < 0.5) return "swale";
  if (p < 0.78) return "storage";
  return "root-zone";
}

export function contourPoint(progress: number): { x: number; y: number } {
  const t = clamp01(progress);
  const x = 8 + 84 * t;
  const y = 18 + 64 * t + 8 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t);
  return { x: Math.round(x * 100) / 100, y: Math.round(y * 100) / 100 };
}

import { waterBudget, watershedPhase } from "./water";

const phaseCopy = {
  ridge: { title: "Read the ridge.", body: "Start above the contour. The first job is to notice where a storm wants to run." },
  swale: { title: "Find the swale.", body: "The line slows the water without turning the field into a channel." },
  storage: { title: "Give it somewhere to stay.", body: "At the middle of the storm, storage is a field decision you can see." },
  "root-zone": { title: "Let roots keep it.", body: "The long way ends below the surface, where water becomes another growing day." },
} as const;

export function WatershedReadout({ rain }: { rain: number }) {
  const phase = watershedPhase(rain / 80);
  const budget = waterBudget(rain);
  const copy = phaseCopy[phase];
  return (
    <div className="rl-land__copy">

      <p className="rl-mono" style={{ marginTop: 18, color: "var(--color-riverstone)" }}>
        {budget.status === "ready" ? "ROOT ZONE / READY" : budget.status === "holding" ? "FIELD / HOLDING" : "FIELD / WAITING"}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { WatershedReadout } from "./WatershedReadout";

const PLATES = [
  { phase: "ridge" as const, asset: "land-aerial", alt: "Aerial contour lines above a dryland ridge" },
  { phase: "swale" as const, asset: "swale-close", alt: "A contour swale holding rain" },
  { phase: "storage" as const, asset: "systems-swale", alt: "A field line slowing water" },
  { phase: "root-zone" as const, asset: "root-zone-macro", alt: "Water settling below a crop root" },
];

export function WatershedStage() {
  const sectionRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const { store, rain } = useWatershed();
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const progress = rain / 80;
  const activePhase = watershedPhase(progress);
  const activeIndex = useMemo(() => PLATES.findIndex((plate) => plate.phase === activePhase), [activePhase]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced) {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--rl-progress", String(progress));
      return;
    }
    let frame = 0;
    const update = () => {
      frame = 0;
      const node = sectionRef.current;
      if (!node) return;
      const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      const inStage = rect.top < window.innerHeight && rect.bottom > 0;
      if (!inStage) return;
      const nextProgress = progressFromOffsets(rect.top, rect.height, window.innerHeight);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--rl-progress", String(nextProgress));
      store.setRain(rainfallAt(nextProgress));
    };
    const schedule = () => { if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(update); };
    update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", schedule);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule); window.removeEventListener("resize", schedule); if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame); };
  }, [progress, reduced, store]);

  return (
    <section ref={sectionRef} className="rl-land" id="land" aria-labelledby="rl-land-title">
      <div className="rl-land__stage">
        <div className="rl-land__media" aria-hidden="true">
          {PLATES.map((plate, index) => (
            <div key={plate.phase} className="rl-land__plate" data-active={index === activeIndex ? "true" : "false"}>
              <Picture assetKey={plate.asset} alt={plate.alt} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="rl-land__veil" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="rl-land__contours" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none">
            <path className="rl-land__contour" pathLength="100" d="M-12 30C12 8 29 17 48 11S79 4 112 19" />
            <path className="rl-land__contour" pathLength="100" d="M-14 44C13 20 32 28 51 21s34-7 63 10" />
            <path className="rl-land__contour" pathLength="100" d="M-15 59c28-24 47-13 65-20s33-6 64 13" />
            <path className="rl-land__contour rl-land__contour--accent" pathLength="100" d="M8 18c23 13 30 26 44 34s28 13 40 30" />
          </svg>
          <span className="rl-land__drop" />
        </div>
        <div className="rl-land__overlay rl-container">
          <WatershedReadout rain={rain} />
          <div className="rl-land__hud">
            <div className="rl-land__hud-head">
              <span className="rl-land__hud-title">Storm route / 042</span>
              <span className="rl-land__hud-unit">mm</span>
            </div>
            <label className="rl-mono" htmlFor="rl-rain-range" style={{ display: "block", marginTop: 18, color: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 64%, transparent)" }}>Rainfall in the field</label>
            <div className="rl-land__hud-value" aria-live="polite">{rain}</div>
            <input id="rl-rain-range" className="rl-land__range" type="range" min="0" max="80" step="1" value={rain} onChange={(event) => store.setRain(Number(event.target.value))} aria-label="Rainfall in millimetres" />
            <div className="rl-land__hud-foot"><span>0 mm / dry</span><span>80 mm / full hold</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <noscript>
        <style>{`.rl-land__fallback-list{display:grid!important}`}</style>
      </noscript>
      <div className="rl-land__fallback-list rl-container" aria-label="Watershed stages">
        {PLATES.map((plate) => <div key={plate.phase}><span className="rl-mono">{plate.phase}</span><p>{plate.alt}</p></div>)}
      </div>
      <span id="rl-land-title" className="rl-visually-hidden">Read the land</span>
    </section>
  );
}

]]>
    </file>

style="--rl-index:0">01 / READ THE LAND</div><h2 class="rl-section-title" style="margin-top:18px;max-width:8ch">A storm is a route.</h2><p class="rl-section-lead" style="margin-top:20px">Follow one Scroll the field or take the gauge in your own hands.</p></div><section class="rl-land" id="land" aria-labelledby="rl-land-title"><div class="rl-land__stage"><div class="rl-land__media" aria-hidden="true"><div class="rl-land__plate" data-active="true"><div class="rl-media-placeholder " role="img" aria-label="Aerial contour lines above a dryland ridge" data-asset="land-aerial"><span class="rl-mono">land-aerial</span></div></div><div class="rl-land__plate" data-active="false"><div class="rl-media-placeholder " role="img" aria-label="A contour swale holding rain" data-asset="swale-close"><span class="rl-mono">swale-close</span></div></div><div class="rl-land__plate" data-active="false"><div class="rl-media-placeholder " role="img" aria-label="A field line slowing water" data-asset="systems-swale"><span class="rl-mono">systems-swale</span></div></div><div class="rl-land__plate" data-active="false"><div class="rl-media-placeholder " role="img" aria-label="Water settling below a crop root" data-asset="root-zone-macro"><span class="rl-mono">root-zone-macro</span></div></div></div><div class="rl-land__veil" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="rl-land__contours" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path class="rl-land__contour" pathLength="100" d="M-12 30C12 8 29 17 48 11S79 4 112 19"></path><path class="rl-land__contour" pathLength="100" d="M-14 44C13 20 32 28 51 21s34-7 63 10"></path><path class="rl-land__contour" pathLength="100" d="M-15 59c28-24 47-13 65-20s33-6 64 13"></path><path class="rl-land__contour rl-land__contour--accent" pathLength="100" d="M8 18c23 13 30 26 44 34s28 13 40 30"></path></svg><span class="rl-land__drop"></span></div><div class="rl-land__overlay rl-container"><div class="rl-land__copy"><span class="rl-land__phase"><span aria-live="polite">ridge</span></span><h2>Read the ridge.</h2><p>Start above the contour. The first job is to notice where a storm wants to run.</p><p class="rl-mono" style="margin-top:18px;color:var(--color-riverstone)">FIELD / WAITING</p></div><div class="rl-land__hud"><div class="rl-land__hud-head"><span class="rl-land__hud-title">Storm route / 042</span><span class="rl-land__hud-unit">mm</span></div><label class="rl-mono" for="rl-rain-range" style="display:block;margin-top:18px;color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-limestone) 64%, transparent)">Rainfall in the field</label><div class="rl-land__hud-value" aria-live="polite">0</div><input id="rl-rain-range" class="rl-land__range" type="range" min="0" max="80" step="1" aria-label="Rainfall in millimetres" value="0"/><div class="rl-land__hud-foot"><span>0 mm / dry</span><span>80 mm / full hold</span></div></div></div></div><noscript><style>.rl-land__fallback-list{display:grid!important}</style></noscript><div class="rl-land__fallback-list rl-container" aria-label="Watershed stages"><div><span class="rl-mono">ridge</span><p>Aerial contour lines above a dryland ridge</p></div><div><span class="rl-mono">swale</span><p>A contour swale holding rain</p></div><div><span class="rl-visually-hidden">Read the land</span></section></div><section class="rl-section rl-budget" id="budget" data-status="dry" aria-labelledby="rl-budget-title"><div class="rl-container rl-budget__grid"><div class="rl-budget__intro"><div class="rl-eyebrow" data-reveal="rise" style="--rl-index:0">02 / WATER BUDGET</div><h2 id="rl-budget-title">Keep the storm in the field.</h2><p>RILL turns a rainfall event into three readable decisions: what leaves, what stays in storage, and what reaches the root zone.</p><div class="rl-rule" data-reveal="line"></div><p class="rl-mono">0–17 mm / waiting for rain</p></div><div class="rl-budget__readout"><div class="rl-budget__readout-head"><span class="rl-budget__readout-title">Live field readout</span><span class="rl-mono">dry</span></div><div class="rl-budget__readout-mm" aria-live="polite">0<!-- --> <span class="rl-mono">mm</span></div><div class="rl-budget__stats"><div class="rl-budget__stat"><span future</span></div></div></div></section><section class="rl-section rl-systems" id="systems" aria-labelledby="rl-systems-title"><div class="rl-container"><div class="rl-section-head rl-section-head--center"><div class="rl-eyebrow" data-reveal="rise" style="--rl-index:0">03 / FIELD SYSTEMS</div><h2 id="rl-systems-title" class="rl-section-title">Small lines. Longer seasons.</h2><p class="rl-section-lead">Three interventions, designed to make the field do less work all at once.</p></div><div class="rl-systems__grid"><article class="rl-tilt-card rl-system-card" data-align="left"><div class="rl-system-card__media"><div class="rl-media-placeholder " role="img" aria-label="Give the ridge somewhere to rest. field study" data-asset="systems-swale"><span class="rl-mono">systems-swale</span></div></div><div class="rl-system-card__body"><div><div class="rl-mono rl-system-card__eyebrow" data-reveal="rise" style="--rl-index:0">LAND / 01</div><h3 class="rl-system-card__title">Give the ridge somewhere to rest.</h3><p class="rl-system-card__copy">A shallow contour swale slows a storm without asking the soil to become a channel. The line is quiet; the effect is cumulative.</p></div><div class="rl-system-card__metric"><span>18% less runoff</span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></div></div></article><article class="rl-tilt-card rl-system-card" data-align="center"><div class="rl-system-card__media"><div class="rl-media-placeholder " role="img" aria-label="Hold a little shadow. field study" data-asset="systems-shade"><span class="rl-mono">systems-shade</span></div></div><div class="rl-system-card__body"><div><div class="rl-mono rl-system-card__eyebrow" data-reveal="rise" style="--rl-index:1">CANOPY / 02</div><h3 class="rl-system-card__title">Hold a little shadow.</h3><p class="rl-system-card__copy">Shade rows soften the hottest hours and keep the surface from giving up its water before roots can reach it.</p></div><div class="rl-system-card__metric"><span>6.4°C cooler soil</span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></div></div></article><article class="rl-tilt-card rl-system-card" data-align="right"><div class="rl-system-card__media"><div class="rl-media-placeholder " role="img" aria-label="Let pressure stay low. field study" data-asset="systems-drip"><span class="rl-mono">systems-drip</span></div></div><div class="rl-system-card__body"><div><div class="rl-mono rl-system-card__eyebrow" data-reveal="rise" style="--rl-index:2">ROOT / 03</div><h3 class="rl-system-card__title">Let pressure stay low.</h3><p class="rl-system-card__copy">A low-pressure line follows the contour and gives each root zone a slower, more useful drink.</p></div><div class="rl-system-card__metric"><span>31 days held</span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></div></div></article></div></div></section><section class="rl-section rl-notes" id="notes" id="rl-notes-title" style="margin-top:18px;max-width:8ch">Proof in the ground.</h2></div><p>Three fields, three storms, one practice: leave the water where the next day can find it.</p></div><div class="rl-notes__rail"><article class="rl-note"><div class="rl-note__media"><div class="rl-media-placeholder " role="img" aria-label="Cienega Fields field note" data-asset="field-note-01"><span class="rl-mono">field-note-01</span></div></div><div class="rl-note__body"><div class="rl-note__top"><div><h3 class="rl-note__farm">Cienega Fields</h3><p class="rl-note__region rl-mono">Mojave edge / class="rl-note__numbers"><div class="rl-note__number"><strong>14</strong><span>acres</span></div><div class="rl-note__number"><strong>42</strong><span>mm storm</span></div><div
